title: Raycast AI agent
description: A centred intro (mono red eyebrow, 32px semibold title, grey lead) above a 1020px bento of three big softly-ringed cards: a wide one with a chat-window slot cropped by a fade, then two side by side (stacked on phones), the first with a prompt box whose cursor blinks over a list of faded suggestions, the second an empty framed panel. A 'learn more' link closes it.
notes: chat window and extensions panel are media slots (token placeholders when empty)
the prompt box is built from the `quick` props; the cursor blink is CSS and stops under reduced motion
